note: #561 (community join CRM) fixes a rules bug in isActiveCommunityMember: get() on a missing communityMembers doc is an evaluation error, not null, so every user without a membership doc was denied wherever the helper is used. firestore.rules auto-deploys on merge: merge needs explicit founder go.

entries.why: #561 owns this change and it is the isActiveCommunityMember helper only: the single get(memberPath) is now guarded by exists(memberPath) in the same short-circuiting condition, so a missing communityMembers doc falls through to the legacy user-doc tenant check instead of erroring and denying. Every other rule is byte-identical. Proven by the existing emulator suites (community, messaging-isolation, permissions, livestream-comments), which were 36 red before and are 583/583 green after.

#561 owns this change: the SPA routing table gains the member /community/:tenantId page (with its resolved-path fixture row), and /dev/join-crm joins the named dev-only previews beside /dev/social-scheduler with the same assertions (notFound() in production, no PublicRouteAnalytics, absent from the analytics registry). No assertion was removed or relaxed; the enumeration comparisons still run over every page file.
